description: The Rare Materials Exchange's texts (core/gameplay/wyporium/exchange_texts.py). 'texts': the messages added to the Wyporium's D_shop file, by language; a '{}' is a number the game fills in (a string slot). 'name' is the menu line (it must fit the menu's 120 pixel pane at font 11) and also the trade list's title (136 pixels at font 10); 'hand_over' is the first line of the materials box (112 pixels, font 10, with the biggest number); 'handed' is the counter in the list's title (136 pixels, font 10, two numbers). 'owners': the owners of a rare item are written under the box's first line as one or two lines of 'line_px' pixels at font 'line_font' (a Helvetica estimate; a longer list ends in 'more'); 'owner_names' gives the English name (of curated/monster_names.json) of an owner of generated/rare_exchange.json that has none of its own, 'proper_names' the owners whose name is the same in every language (the ported monsters').
